theme: A quiet day at sea before the long haul home.
greeting: The calendar is empty, Dan — open water on the Adriatic with the girls in Florida. The next few days are pure logistics: off the boat Saturday, fly Sunday, land in St. Pete.

needsAttention.title: Rental car for the TPA landing
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV (Trips, overdue Sept 9) still isn't booked. You land TPA Sunday at 3:55 PM — don't arrive jet-lagged to walk-up rates.

needsAttention.title: St. Pete beds for Sept 20–21
needsAttention.detail: The landing-gap nights before the Tuesday kid pickup (Trips, overdue) are still unbooked — you need somewhere near St. Pete for Sunday and Monday.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the St. Pete Airbnb
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 27–Oct 5 Airbnb charges tomorrow, Sept 18. Worth a glance that it actually converted to confirmed rather than quietly expiring.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat checkout and airport taxi
needsAttention.detail: Off the boat Saturday noon: lock the Komolac→Cavtat transfer, the bag hold, and a ~5:15 AM Sunday checkout and taxi for the 7:30 flight — while you still have shore signal.

flagged.title: SEC moves to scrap the shareholder-proposal rule
flagged.detail: Responsible Investor flags a proposal to rescind the longstanding rule — squarely your governance beat.

flagged.title: Revolut account is live
flagged.detail: Verification, card order, and a $366 transfer all confirmed today — your travel-money setup went through.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, hotel promos, and retail — nothing awaiting a reply.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash pie
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings in from the garden and market.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV — refundable, PWM

acts.line: Nothing scheduled — sailing time on the Adriatic.
The calendar stays clear straight through tomorrow.
A good window to lock the car and the St. Pete gap nights before signal thins.
